description: This file defines the AuthTokenGenerator class responsible for generating RDS authentication tokens using AWS credentials, intended for use with IAM authentication mechanisms.

classes.name: AuthTokenGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates RDS IAM authentication tokens for database connections.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the generator with AWS credentials or a provider.

methods.name: createToken
methods.description: Creates an authentication token for connecting to an RDS instance with specified endpoint, region, username, and token lifetime.
